# BOTIA — Food Transparency
BOTIA is a food transparency tool that reads ingredient lists from food labels and provides clear explanations based on scientific and regulatory evidence.

## Core Pages
- Home: https://www.botia-safefood.com/index.html
- Evidence Layers: https://www.botia-safefood.com/pages/evidence.html
- Woman: https://www.botia-safefood.com/pages/woman.html
- Animal Origin: https://www.botia-safefood.com/pages/animal.html
- Muslim Choice: https://www.botia-safefood.com/pages/muslim.html
- Ingredient Index: https://www.botia-safefood.com/ingredients/index.html
- Privacy Policy: https://www.botia-safefood.com/privacy.html
